    have h_event := h (ε / 2) hε2pos

      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using h_event
    rcases Filter.mem_atTop_sets.mp h_event' with ⟨N, hN⟩
    refine ⟨N + 1, by omega, λ n m hn hm => ?_⟩
    have hnN : N ≤ n := by omega
    have hmN : N ≤ m := by omega
    have hxnx : |xSeq n - x| < ε / 2 := hN n hnN
    have hxmx : |xSeq m - x| < ε / 2 := hN m hmN
    have h_tri : |xSeq n - xSeq m| ≤ |xSeq n - x| + |x - xSeq m| := by

        |xSeq n - xSeq m| = |(xSeq n - x) + (x - xSeq m)| := by ring
        _ ≤ |xSeq n - x| + |x - xSeq m| := abs_add _ _
    have h_comm : |x - xSeq m| = |xSeq m - x| := by rw [abs_sub_comm]
    rw [h_comm] at h_tri
    have hsum : |xSeq n - x| + |xSeq m - x| < ε := by linarith
    linarith
  · intro h
    intro ε hε
    rcases h ε hε with ⟨N, hNpos, hN⟩
    refine Filter.mem_atTop_sets.mpr ?_
